pages.text: The Keepers of the Remainder studied not only what a proof changes, but what survives its enactment. Their recursive work became $(l)metamagic$(): magic whose subject is the cost of later magic.$(br2)It still obeys typed runes, witnesses, plans, and explicit execution.

pages.title: Four Tiers
pages.text: $(li)I: Fundamental$(li)II: Refined$(li)III: Arcane$(li)IV: Metamagical$(br2)A proof inherits the highest tier among its runes. Tier I is the baseline. Higher tiers require a material witness of at least the same tier.

pages.title: A Witness Must Work
pages.text: A high-tier item is not a decorative key. It must contribute a required attribute, supply budget that the graph actually needs, or satisfy a fixed item cost.$(br2)The Resources screen shows required and contributing tiers. Unrelated filler cannot unlock a proof.

pages.title: Snapshot Rule
pages.text: At the beginning of a cast, the server records active metamagic and builds one immutable cost plan. Effects created by that cast cannot reduce their own price.$(br2)Axiom of Parsimony therefore consumes its full witnesses before helping the next spell.

pages.title: Parsimony
pages.text: Parsimony reduces every positive attribute requirement of later casts by 1 per effect level, to a maximum reduction of 2. A requirement never falls below 1.$(br2)It does not reduce fixed items, graph budget, or required tier.

pages.title: Conservation
pages.text: Conservation gives each consumed item unit a 15% survival chance per effect level, capped at 45%. The player must still possess the complete planned cost before casting.$(br2)Catalysts already survive and do not roll.

pages.title: Axiomatic Ink
pages.text: Tier IV, consumed. Its dragon breath, echo, lapis, and amethyst carry metamagic and economy. The Axiom of Parsimony needs two measures at base cost.

pages.title: Recursive Seal
pages.text: Tier IV catalyst. A nether star closes the seal while echo shards and pearls preserve the remainder. It carries metamagic, conservation, and stability.

pages.title: Building Plans
pages.text: Parsimony Plan and Conservation Plan produce $(l)Effect Plan$() values. Connect entities, duration, and level, then conclude with Execute Plan.$(br2)The Laboratory offers self-targeting forms; their plan remains editable before execution is added.

pages.title: Pack Authority
pages.text: KubeJS may tune rune tiers, material tiers, attributes, budget, and consumption. Java retains effect behavior, caps, random rolls, and server authority.$(br2)Metamagic changes accounting, never permission: it cannot bypass target safety or unsupported executors.
